## About
We're car people, and we treat your car like we treat ours. Whether it belonged to a late family member or it was your first, we know it's more like a family member than just a car.
Tallant's is family owned and operated, and the guys in our shop have become our extended family. We specialize in hot rods, classics, muscle cars and customs, and we still do the little things on everyday drivers too.
Our customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 47 Google reviews. We hope to stick with you for life: your vehicles, your kids' vehicles and maybe someday your grandkids'.

## Services
- Fabrication: Boxed frames, custom-built steel-tube frames, headers for makes and models nobody else makes them for, and roll-bar installs, made in steel or aluminum.
- Restoration, customization & turn key cars: Turn an old original into a street rod, put the muscle back in your muscle car, or have us build you a car from scratch.
- Body work: Custom body work on street rods and collision repair on daily drivers, in metal or fiberglass. From chopping and channeling to frenched headlights and hood scoops.
- Paint work: Our in house paint shop does one type of paint job, Tallant Quality. For us, the only difference between a driver and a show car is the bottom of the car.
- Engine service: Tune-ups to build-ups, power adders like Superchargers, ProChargers or a roots style blower, engine swaps and new EFI systems.
- Upholstery: Basic upholstery in house, like new carpet, seat belts or a custom console. For something more custom, we'll point you to professional upholsterers we know and trust.
- Pre-Season look-over: Bring your vehicle by before the driving season and we'll look it over.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on hot rods?
A: No. We specialize in classic cars and customs, but we do the little things too.

Q: What should I include when I contact you about a project?
A: Your name, phone number and email, the year, make and model of your vehicle, and a short description of the work, whether it's mechanical like an engine swap, brakes, AC or wiring, or fabrication, body and paint.

Q: Do you send any work out?
A: Only custom interiors and select EFI tuning. Those fields are a craft in themselves, so we leave them to the experts.

Q: How do I start a build?
A: Give us a call to schedule a consultation for your build.
